title: Self-Bootstrapping Automated Program Repair: Using LLMs to Generate and Evaluate Synthetic Training Data for Bug Repair
abstract: arXiv:2505.07372v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper presents a novel methodology for enhancing Automated Program Repair (APR) through synthetic data generation utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs). Current APR systems are constrained by the limited availability of high-quality training data encompassing diverse bug types across multiple programming languages. The proposed approach addresses this limitation through a two-phase process: a synthetic sample generation followed by a rigorous quality assessment. Multiple state-of-the-art LLMs were employed to generate approximately 30,000 paired examples of buggy and fixed code across 12 programming languages and 13 bug categories. Subsequently, these samples underwent cross-model evaluation against five criteria: correctness, code quality, security, performance, and completeness. translated_title: 自举式自动化程序修复：利用大型语言模型生成和评估用于缺陷修复的合成训练数据
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种通过利用大型语言模型（LLMs）生成合成数据来增强自动化程序修复（APR）的新方法。当前的APR系统受限于高质量训练数据的有限可用性，这些数据需要涵盖多种编程语言中的多种缺陷类型。所提出的方法通过两个阶段的过程解决了这一限制：首先是合成样本生成，其次是严格的质量评估。使用了多个最先进的LLMs，在12种编程语言和13种缺陷类别中生成约30,000个配对的有缺陷和修复后的代码示例。随后，这些样本通过跨模型评估，依据五个标准进行：正确性、代码质量、安全性、性能和完整性。在VulRepair测试集上的实验评估显示，完美预测率有统计显著的提升，其中q
tldr: 本文提出了一种自举式方法，利用大型语言模型生成和评估合成训练数据，以增强自动化程序修复的性能，实验显示在VulRepair测试集上显著提高了完美预测率。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a self-bootstrapping approach that uses LLMs to generate and evaluate synthetic training data for enhancing automated program repair, showing statistically significant improvements in perfect prediction rates on the VulRepair test set.
